title: Capital Credits (Patronage Capital) Schedule of Records Charges on Replacement Checks
content:
# Schedule of Records Charges on Replacement Checks

**Capital Credits (Patronage Capital).** The records charge of a replacement follows how long the voided amount has been held, the full calendar months from the most recent void to the replacement:

| Full calendar months from the most recent void to the replacement | Records charge |
|---|---|
| at least 12 | $5.00 |
| at least 3 and fewer than 12 | $2.50 |
| fewer than 3 | none |

The most recent void is the latest void entry on the capital account; the months are counted from its entry date to the date of the replacement. The charge is deducted from the face of the replacement and recorded among the charges deducted from it.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, most recent void dated 2025-04-14)

| Replacement on | Full months held | Records charge |
|---|---|---|
| 2025-07-13 | 2 | none |
| 2025-07-14 | 3 | $2.50 |
| 2026-04-13 | 11 | $2.50 |
| 2026-04-14 | 12 | $5.00 |
